title: funcd security kind: flow
[Asks RBAC] teal right api: API | control-plane writes @red edge: Edge | authenticated routes @red rbacq: RBAC allows? | admin, developer, viewer @purple [/]
[Asks Cedar] blue right local: Local API | KV, Bucket, SQL, Secret, calls @red s3: S3 gateway | Buckets @red lakegw: Lake gateway | queries @red egress: Egress gateway | outbound connections @red cedarq: Cedar allows? | data-plane actions @purple policy: Policy | Cedar text @amber roles: RolesAssignment | Roles at a scope @amber egresspol: EgressPolicy | allowed destinations @amber [/]
api > rbacq edge > rbacq local > cedarq s3 > cedarq lakegw > cedarq egress > cedarq cedarq ~> policy, roles, egresspol: reads
